original_test_intent: Verify NVSM aggregate and per-PSU power information is complete, correctly dimensioned and within the approved input/output/redundancy envelope with every PSU healthy.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; load PSU slot/serial/feed/rating/redundancy and power-rail metric/unit/range manifest; record system load and mode; run exact `nvsm show power` read-only; retain raw values/status/health; reconcile aggregate versus per-PSU totals and compare ranges/headroom without changing power policy.
manual_activity: Power/platform owner supplies PSU/feed/redundancy and metric-range manifest and dispositions every missing, out-of-range or non-OK item.
required_inputs: Current system load/power mode and headroom policy
safety_requirements: Never clear logs or change power mode/caps/PSU state
Do not infer redundancy from PSU count alone

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The query is applicable but lacks PSU identity/feed topology, units and normal ranges.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal command and compare aggregate and per-PSU metrics to the approved load/redundancy envelope.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All power information and all PSU health states remain in scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build per-PSU/feed and aggregate power tables with units, ratings, measured load, redundancy/headroom and health.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: PSU presence alone cannot prove power distribution or redundancy headroom.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Instantaneous readings fluctuate and telemetry resolution may be coarse; timestamp/load context is required.

project_override_considerations: Power owner defines redundancy mode, feed mapping, allowed imbalance and load-dependent ranges.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target power information and PSU health; missing electrical manifest is a project input and log clearing is rejected for safety.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and power manifest are provisionable; collection is read-only.

review_improvement: Adds feed/redundancy and unit-aware aggregate reconciliation without changing system power controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: Two healthy PSUs do not necessarily provide redundancy if they share a failed feed or current load exceeds survivor capacity. Slot/feed identity, ratings and measured load are required to interpret both health and headroom.
